maddeler.e:
أستبرأ (form X)
# أُسْتَبْرَأُ (ʔustabraʔu) /ʔus.tab.ra.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَبْرَأَ (istabraʔa)
# أُسْتَبْرَأَ (ʔustabraʔa) /ʔus.tab.ra.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past passive subjunctive of اِسْتَبْرَأَ (istabraʔa)
# أُسْتَبْرَأْ (ʔustabraʔ) /ʔus.tab.raʔ/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَبْرَأَ (istabraʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
